definitions.gloss: physical strength; brawn; strength in a fight
definitions.explanation: Strength of the arms, especially as used in fighting or hard physical work.

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}っぷし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
{腕|うで}っぷし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.english: He's small, but nobody beats him for brawn.

notes:
A colloquial word, mostly in 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧. It suggests strength in a scuffle or manual labour rather than athletic strength.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腕|うで}っぷし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: strong, good in a fight
- {腕|うで}っぷし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: confident in one's strength

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{腕力|わんりょく}→腕力：08517_wanryoku⟧: arm strength, brute force — more neutral, and also used of force used to get one's way
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧: arm; also skill (⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧)
